statement: The finite 2-subgroups of the full once-punctured-torus loop-outer group have exactly the abstract types 1, C2, C4, C2 times C2, and D8 of order eight, all realized by explicit full profinite free-group automorphisms. Every V4 or D8 subgroup has globally signed multipliers with the stated standard determinant character. For an arbitrary cyclic C4 generator, the exact restrictions remain lambda squared equals 1 globally and lambda at 2 equals 1; its square has global multiplier 1.
depends_on: D33 exact primary homology injection and order-eight bound; D43 global multiplier of every torus involution; explicit 2-adic matrix centralizer and valuation arguments; free profinite universal property
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), full loop-outer finite actions in type (1,1)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The finite matrix representation is the exact primary homology map already proved injective on finite 2-subgroups. The quaternion obstruction includes the complete Q2 valuation calculation, and all five abstract types are supplied by explicit generator maps.
notes: An order-four matrix has square minus the identity. Its centralizer is Q2(i), whose finite 2-torsion has at most four elements. For an order-eight image, an element outside that cyclic centralizer either squares to 1, giving D8, or squares to minus the identity. The latter forces a squared plus b squared equals minus 1 in Q2; minimum valuation followed by reductions modulo eight and four excludes it. The explicit automorphisms r(x)=y,r(y)=x inverse and s(x)=y,s(y)=x preserve the full torus cusp with multipliers 1 and minus 1, satisfy the D8 relations, and have eight distinct homology matrices. This is an abstract subgroup classification, not a conjugacy classification. No common faithfulness at odd primes is asserted, and the arbitrary cyclic C4 mixed-sign multiplier problem remains open.
